name: ModelVariant666_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant666_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three blooms hover in a circle above the model, each a pulsing square that launches a spark on every pulse; a spark draws a fading line from its bloom towards a target point and, a quarter of the way through its life, opens a ring of eight textured triangles round a centre square); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs three texture images and seeds the blooms from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 once after frame 432, 4 while a spark or ring is live before that, 2 once every bloom, spark and ring is inactive and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-683 and 750 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
